in_sanskrit.name: अधर्वा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is free from fear, courageous, and brave. Derived from the root word 'adh' (meaning 'fear') and 'hr' (meaning 'remover').

in_hindi.name: अधर्वण
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is more fearless, manly, and pleasing. Derived from the root word 'adh' (meaning 'fear') and 'rvan' (meaning 'remover').

in_tamil.name: அதிர்வு
in_tamil.meaning: அதிக தேவை, அதிக விரட்டம், அதிக அரிர்ச்சியம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses great strength, great courage, and great power. Derived from the root word 'adh' (meaning 'great') and 'iruvu' (meaning 'presence').

in_telugu.name: ఆధర్వణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is the lord of courage, the remover of fear, and the possessor of immense strength. Derived from the root word 'adh' (meaning 'fear') and 'van' (meaning 'remover').

in_marathi.name: Daring
in_marathi.long_meaning: Daring हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name for someone who is brave, fearless, and not afraid to take risks.

in_bengali.name: Daring
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bold, brave
in_bengali.long_meaning: Daring একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name for someone who is brave, fearless, and not afraid to take risks.
